origin.basis: Challenge says it has roots in Italy, the United States and Thailand (company page).

manufacturing.basis: Challenge says all its handmade tires are made in its family-owned factory in Thailand.

availability.note: Sold by Challenge's US web store; its European storefront was not read for this tire.

name: Elite Pro TLR (2026)
positioning: Challenge's entry handmade tubeless-ready road tire for year-round miles.
caveats: Not in Challenge's hookless size list (handmade TLR from 33C).

price_observations.conditions: Official store price on 2026-11-01; one tire; shipping and tax at checkout.

image.shown: 28 mm tan-wall Elite Pro TLR, the store's photo for that option; a black version is also sold.
image.alt: Challenge Elite Pro TLR road tire with tan sidewalls

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-04 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, reviews without riding detail, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out. Comments on one construction's test page count for that construction unless the owner names the other.

checks.note: Only the Elite XP is listed
